span.p: New evidence and failures

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; font-size: 22px !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: MUFASA Model Training Pipeline

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
0 - Scope and Governance
African evidence-first domains, countries and languages
Scientific taxonomy, rights, consent and safety

div.style: color: rgb(18, 59, 24) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1 - Discover and Acquire Sources
Articles, preprints, theses, dissertations and proceedings
Technical reports, OER, datasets, patents and partner archives
AfricArXiv, repositories, AJOL, OpenAlex, Crossref and CORE

div.style: color: rgb(101, 16, 54) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Licence and ethics approved
for this exact full text?

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Metadata only or quarantine

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2 - Data Engineering
Native XML/HTML, GROBID PDF parsing and OCR for scans
Recover tables, equations and citations; normalize units
Link versions, deduplicate and retain source spans

div.style: color: rgb(101, 16, 54) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3 - Freeze Leakage-Safe Splits
Group paper families, thesis versions and near duplicates
Train, development, held-out test and challenge set

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4 - Build Scientific Knowledge
Extract methods, variables, conditions, results and limitations
Create claim ledger plus evidence-linked knowledge graph
Validate numbers, units, citations and high-risk claims

div.style: color: rgb(13, 49, 90) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5 - Create Model Datasets
Optional CPT corpus, evidence bundles and reasoning SFT JSONL
Teacher generation, automatic checks and expert review
Frozen benchmark for grounding, reasoning, calibration and safety

div.style: color: rgb(0, 70, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
6A - Base Model Benchmarking
Qwen3-4B Thinking and Qwen3-8B Thinking
Gemma 3 4B and Phi-4 Mini Reasoning
Intel DeepMath v1
Compare science quality, grounding, speed, memory and licence

div.style: color: rgb(52, 16, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
6B - Select and Adapt the Base Model
Choose the strongest model that meets deployment constraints
Optional BF16 continued pretraining for a proven knowledge gap
Reasoning SFT with BF16 LoRA by default

div.style: color: rgb(0, 70, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SFT improves facts, grounding
and reasoning without regressions?

div.style: color: rgb(93, 69, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
7 - Build Scientific Preferences
Failure-focused prompts produce 4-8 candidate answers
Expert rubric creates prompt, chosen and hard-rejected pairs
Check evidence, calculations, local fit, uncertainty and safety

div.style: color: rgb(52, 16, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
8 - Reinforcement Learning (DPO)
Direct Preference Optimization from the approved SFT model
Tune beta; monitor KL and preference margins
Blind Base vs SFT vs DPO evaluation

div.style: color: rgb(0, 70, 77) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
DPO improves preferences
without factual regression?

div.style: color: rgb(101, 16, 54) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
9 - Deployment Decision
Is BF16 already small and fast enough?

div.style: color: rgb(60, 15, 79) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Keep BF16/FP16
for maximum fidelity

div.style: color: rgb(60, 15, 79) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Test INT8 or 4-bit
AWQ, GPTQ or GGUF
against the BF16 benchmark

div.style: color: rgb(60, 15, 79) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
10 - Offline Release and Improvement
Validated runtime, tokenizer, prompt template and checksums
Model/data cards, evidence interface and corrections
New approved literature feeds the next version
